title: Changing the pump resets superbolus
symptom: When superbolus is active and the pump is changed, AAPS sets default basal rate and deactivates superbolus mode, despite superbolus being active and basal rate should be zero for the next 2 hours.
cause: Changing the pump resets the running TBR, which is pump specific and not handled by AAPS. The issue is that superbolus is tied to the pump and not stored independently.
evidence_quote: yes, changing pump resets running TBR. That's pump specific and will not be handled by AAPS
